description: Get this repository's design system: the colors, spacing, typography, radius, shadow and motion values it defines (CSS custom properties, Tailwind theme, tokens.json, Sass variables, DESIGN.md). Call this before writing any CSS, inline style or Tailwind class, so the UI you write uses the project's values instead of new ones. Repos with no tokens get the values their code already uses most. Filter by category (color, spacing, typography, shadow, border, sizing, motion, zIndex) or a name substring.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the token name

name: list_design_tokens
title: List design tokens
